PFS was also poor (2.1 months in Cohort A, 7.2 months in Cohort B). 4. POPULATION EFFECTS: No subgroup analyses reported. The trial enrolled patients with BAP1 and other DNA damage response deficient tumors, which should theoretically be sensitive to PARP inhibition. 5. CONFOUNDERS: This was a single-arm Phase 2 trial with small sample size (N=37) and short duration (4 weeks per cycle). The trial appears adequately powered for a Phase 2 ORR study. High rates of serious adverse events (hematologic and GI toxicities) are consistent with known niraparib toxicity profile but don't appear to have limited dosing below therapeutic levels.
